findings.title: Lease guard's renewal failure is not surfaced to an already-blocked check!; the store-side fenced commit is the real guarantee and is undocumented as such
findings.recommendation: No code change: the store-side fenced transaction already delivers invariant 20. Add one line at lease.rb:41-44 stating the store-side check is the authoritative fence and check! is an early abort.

findings.title: No graph-level stream signal distinguishes an ambiguous effect (:unknown) from a node failure
findings.recommendation: Smallest action: correct documentation/design/graph.md so the :effect_unknown emission is attributed to the dispatcher rather than the graph. If a graph-level signal is wanted, add an effects projection at stream_emitter.rb:5-13.

carried_forward.row_relevance: The graph's replay path removes already-pending task ids from to_execute (executor.rb:35-36), so a recorded node never replays. The dispatcher is reached when a node IS invoked and re-enters EffectDispatcher.run (effect_dispatcher.rb:33-67); the graph does not participate in receipt selection.

The graph derives effect keys from the active writer lease (effect_journal_key.rb:24-45, supplied by execution_support.rb:79-92 and durable_runner.rb:66-71). The missing row-scope comparison is entirely at EffectReconciler#resolve, not in the graph namespace derivation.

probes.name: kill-window replay probe
probes.method: SQLite-backed graph; real fault_injector fires Process.kill('KILL', Process.pid) at the first data-barrier checkpoint.commit, i.e. after append_writes recorded the task activation and before the barrier commit. Child exited 137. After the 30s lease TTL, a second process ran DurableRunner#recover.
probes.result: status=completed state={:log=>["a-exec-1"]} runs=1 — node executed exactly once, pending activation survived the kill, recovery returned the recorded outcome.

probes.name: codec version-refusal probe
probes.method: Mutated a real dumped checkpoint envelope: top-level format version 99 with poisoned fields at indices 9-14; a truncated (10-item) envelope; and a stored pending-routes sub-record at version 99.
probes.result: future version => CheckpointVersionError 'unsupported checkpoint format version 99' (before any field read); short envelope => CheckpointCorruptionError 'must be an Array with 16 items'; routes sub-record v99 => CheckpointVersionError 'pending routes format is unsupported'. All refused; none coerced.

probes.name: lease-fencing probe
probes.scratch: same session as the kill-window probe
probes.method: Attempted DurableRunner#recover immediately after the kill, before TTL expiry.
probes.result: CheckpointConflictError 'thread namespace already has an unexpired lease' — a second writer cannot take a live fence.
